people.name: Jehoshaphat
people.line: Son of Asa, king of Judah.

translations.web: So the realm of Jehoshaphat was quiet, for his God gave him rest all around.
translations.bsb: Then Jehoshaphat’s kingdom was at peace, for his God had given him rest on every side.
translations.kjv: So the realm of Jehoshaphat was quiet: for his God gave him rest round about.
translations.asv: So the realm of Jehoshaphat was quiet; for his God gave him rest round about.
